$comment: Google bridge profile — TEMPLATE. Copy to config/google.profile.json (git-ignored) and fill the layout IDs. Code resolves logical names ('memory/long'), never account emails or raw Drive IDs. One profile = one Google account; swap = change GOOGLE_PROFILE + its refresh-token secret, zero code changes. Policy: docs/google-setup.md, google-bridge.md §3.
$schema_note: layout values stay null until `bootstrap` creates the folders; a null value means 'not bootstrapped for this profile' and the gateway falls back to `fallback`.
purpose: development and testing only — demo data, never a real guardian's contact data
auth_mode_reason: Apps Script Script Properties cannot be read by an outside process, so a bridge token would need rclone's extended scope on the account; GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID/SECRET/REFRESH_TOKEN keeps the same app registration usable from GitHub Actions and Colab without a card or a domain.

scope_notes.drive.file: per-file: the app sees only what it created — non-sensitive, no verification needed
scope_notes.spreadsheets: index sheet inside the app-created root folder
scope_notes.calendar.events: read/write the clinic calendar events only (no calendar management)

function_map_note: mail = none on purpose: no Gmail scope is requested, so a leak cannot expose a mailbox. state stays Sheets because it is already the system of record (Code.gs) — do not split hot state across two stores.
backup_outside_google: encrypted archive → private GitHub repo or local disk (docs/google-setup.md §5)
